site.description: Personal website of Jonathan González — Technology & Security Architecture Leader (CTO / CISO / Head of Architecture)

home.bio: Technology and security architecture leader with 25 years of experience across transformation, cybersecurity, cloud and critical 24/7 environments. Established Schneider Electric's first coordinated global cloud security strategy, securing funding and delivering a multi-project program. At AWS, led security transformation engagements across EMEA, with multi-application mass migrations delivered in short periods of time. Currently owns cloud security architecture for a 24/7 IoT environment serving millions customers in several countries.

hero.tag: // technology leadership — CTO / CISO / Head of Architecture
hero.heading: Hi, I'm Jonathan González.

about.location: Based in Spain — Working hybrid across the EU, remote-friendly worldwide

experience.context: Millions of monitored customers across 18 countries in Europe and South America; 24/7 alarm receiving centers.
highlights: Cloud security architecture across AWS and Azure, setting requirements, reference patterns and technical direction for enterprise cloud initiatives.
Led the CNAPP selection: defined the assessment criteria and competitive test plan across vendors.
Drive security architecture for identity, resilience and the modernization of alarm-processing services spanning cloud, edge and on-premises systems.
Define security architectures for 24/7 monitoring and IoT platforms serving millions of connected devices with low-latency real-time processing.

experience.context: Independent architecture practice across transformation, cybersecurity, domain architecture and industrial IoT. Cryptographic product IP sold.
highlights: Payments organization (Germany): Designed an AWS infrastructure migration strategy including a new landing zone and Lacework CNAPP, then executed the migration of multiple apps and hundreds of microservices to AWS in 9 months.

Energy organization (Spain): Redesigned the architecture service model supporting a large-scale Azure-to-AWS migration, improving how architecture supported cloud agility, decision-making and migration delivery.

Energy organization (UK): Acted as cloud architect and IoT subject-matter expert on industrial IoT initiatives, including smart electricity-metering projects and their cloud integration with corporate apps.
Airline (Spain): Domain architect for Customer Experience, Loyalty and Payments; defined the target architecture adopted as the reference for three delivery teams.

Industrial MSSP (Spain): Designed an AI-assisted anomaly-detection architecture combining an eBPF network and process analyzer with local AI models running at the workload. First-pass detection and assessment report to a local management station; only selected findings escalate to more capable models for deeper correlation. The architecture balanced detection depth, latency, privacy, bandwidth, resilience and cloud AI cost.
Designed and developed a cryptographic product for distributed data-masking; IP later acquired.

experience.role: Security Team Leader – Global Financial Services
experience.context: Delivered security and transformation engagements for multiple tier-1 banks, a DeFi exchange and a national land registry across Europe.
highlights: Led security architecture and transformation work across EMEA, with selected engagements in the Americas, working with Directors, VPs and C-suite stakeholders on large-scale AWS migration and modernization programs.
Managed a team of security specialists while sustaining >85% direct customer delivery utilization.

Led an internal technical upskilling program for two consecutive years, coordinating dozens of professionals through a 12-week development program while maintaining customer delivery and team-lead responsibilities.

Owned the security architecture on a competitive bid for a tier-1 European bank's enterprise data lake, resolving critical security and data-protection objections and contributing to AWS winning the evaluation.
For a top-tier African bank, coordinated several outsourced engineers during a replatforming migration that moved dozens of applications to AWS in weeks using the AWS migration framework.

Delivered security architecture across cryptography, data protection, microsegmentation, data migration, data platforms, MLOps and early generative-AI use cases, translating regulatory and security requirements into executable technical roadmaps and implementation plans.

experience.role: Cloud Security Architect (CCoE) & Digital Risk Leader
experience.context: Global cloud security transformation spanning 100+ countries and hundreds of internal development teams.
highlights: Established Schneider Electric's first coordinated global cloud security strategy from within the Cloud Center of Excellence, beginning with an enterprise gap assessment and defining the strategy, charter and delivery program.
Built the business case, secured funding and translated the strategy into a portfolio of multiple security projects across AWS and Azure, leading execution with a team of up to four people.

Established common requirements for identity, data protection, governance, CSPM and workload protection, aligned with ISO 27001 and applicable NIS requirements while supporting the agility of the wider cloud transformation.
Defined KPIs and management dashboards to track execution, project progress and security posture, reporting periodically to senior leadership; drastic reduction in reported incidents over 24 months.
